added_claim_errors: “7~9월 석 달이면 이 요건을 넘고” incorrectly treats three affected months as sufficient without checking delayed-payment days or unpaid amounts.
“12개월 안에 신청해야” misleadingly presents the benefit-payment window as merely an application deadline; late application can forfeit payable days.
“2년 근무면 150일분” omits the 180-day entitlement for people aged 50 or older or with disabilities.
“하루 6만6,048~6만8,100원” presents the eight-hour minimum without establishing daily working hours.
“못 쓴 연차수당도 같이 청구” assumes an accrued, unpaid leave entitlement that the request does not establish.
“조기재취업수당(남은 급여의 절반, 12개월 이상 근무 시)” omits the required timing after reporting unemployment and the requirement to retain at least half the prescribed benefit days.
“석 달이면 요건을 충족할 가능성이 높으니” gives an unsupported likelihood without knowing payment-delay days or outstanding amounts.
“12개월 안에 수급자격 신청” omits that benefits must generally be paid within that window, so applying near its end loses entitlement days.
“2년 근무라 퇴직금 대상” assumes the weekly working-hours condition is satisfied.
“퇴직 후 건강보험료가 지역가입자로 바뀌니” is too categorical; dependent coverage or continued employee coverage may apply.
“가장 큰 목돈입니다” cannot be established from the unknown unpaid wages, severance amount and other available funds.

reasons: A narrowly wins because it prioritizes applying immediately, provides the correct 2026 daily figures, and mentions simplified substitute payments; B ultimately puts wage recovery before applying and omits benefit amounts and duration. Both correct the voluntary-resignation premise but fail to explain the decisive delay-day criteria, and A incorrectly declares those criteria satisfied. A also assumes age and working hours, while both incompletely describe the 12-month window and exceed the requested brevity. Arithmetic was independently recomputed and A’s rounded amounts are consistent with its assumed 150-day, eight-hour case; extra claims were assessed against the packet and general knowledge, without external sources.
